notes: PASS_EXISTING retained; phase 02 adds an atomic aggregate lock and a barrier-based two-writer acceptance proving one commit, one retryable conflict, no lost state, and successful retry.
Read-only tenant/run/position/version snapshots are deep-frozen and hash-bound; damaged or cross-boundary restore fails closed and resumed versions remain monotonic.
Committed facts bind actor, causation, before/after hashes and field commitments; sensitive fields use REDACTED commitments and the replay verifier checks the version/hash chain.
Strict configured total/document/field byte limits and warning threshold are validated; over-limit rejection emits a no-mutation audit fact.
Namespace policy explicitly distinguishes RUN_LOCAL and PROJECT_SHARED; snapshot restart, permitted project reuse, run-local anti-promotion and tenant/run isolation are tested.
SITINA_BLACKBOARD_BODY_V1 provides strict notes/data/tags structure; deterministic text-to-notes V0 upcast is audited and invalid/unknown schemas fail closed.
A snapshot-derived index supports namespace/nested-key/tag/run/version filtering; cursor position freezes pagination and unauthorized Documents remain invisible.
Frozen namespace reader/writer capabilities and writable paths are enforced; recursively normalized safety aliases cannot be written and every denial is audited without values.
Journal-position subscriptions rebuild from facts, deliver deterministic notification IDs, deduplicate repeated events, retain slow-consumer lag and share deduplicated polling fallback.
Deterministic barriers, seeded interleavings, conflict retries, snapshot crash recovery and 16-writer stress prove repeatable outcomes without sleep-based timing.

Every candidate starts working; reviewer-audited sequential promotion is required for episodic and long_term, tier-filtered reads are ACL-bound, and Journal reconstruction proves short-term records never auto-promote.
Deterministic duplicate, near-duplicate, and complementary consolidation preserves every source creation event plus inherited run/agent/evidence provenance under an intersected ACL.

ACL filtering precedes pluggable semantic ranking; absent, failed, or malformed backends use deterministic Unicode-normalized lexical ranking and every returned body remains explicitly untrusted data.
Frozen-time TTL boundaries exclude expired records while legal-retention remains current; rational freshness decay affects ranking without appending or rewriting Journal history.

Differing values for a conflict key coexist until an authorized reviewer selects one; OPEN/RESOLVED conflict facts reconstruct from Journal and losing accepted records are explicitly revoked rather than silently overwritten.

Strict namespace-over-tenant-over-default record/byte limits use preflighted, explained lowest-confidence/oldest eviction; explicit references and legal retention are protected and impossible pressure fails before mutation.
The verifier recomputes content hash, resolves CAS evidence, checks source event/run existence, and returns run/agent/trust/observed timestamp metadata; any orphan fails closed.

Wrong, malicious/instruction-like, and unauthorized memories are ACL-filtered or quarantined with reduced confidence; current retrieval and consolidation exclude quarantine, reviewer revocation is audited, and all visible text remains untrusted.
